Determine the elbow cutoff to be used to run UMAP

Source: R/kvsElbow.R
kvsElbow.Rd

Determine the elbow cutoff to be used to run UMAP

Usage

kvsElbow(variance, method = c("distance", "zscore"), zScoreCutoff = 2.5)

Arguments

variance

Standard deviations of the LSI components, stored in a Seurat object as seuratObj@reductions$lsi@stdev. Must be sorted in decreasing order.

method

Which elbow-detection method to use. One of:

"distance" (default)

Returns the point of the (smoothed) scree curve that lies farthest from the chord connecting its endpoints. Light spline smoothing keeps it from being thrown off by jitter in the noisy tail, and it needs no threshold.

"zscore"

Flags the stepwise drops (1st derivative) that are statistical outliers via a robust z-score and returns the last such drop. Sensitive to the zScoreCutoff threshold.

zScoreCutoff

Integer indicating the cut off value for the Z-score. Only used when method = "zscore".

Value

A list with element elbow_cutoff: the index of the last LSI component to use (at least 2).

Details

Short scree curves (fewer than 50 components, i.e. inputs with 50 or fewer gene sets) are supported. With fewer than four components after dropping the first one, all components are used.
